text:
ops-bot: Incident created: GPU memory surge detected on prefill path - id=7054321987
oncall_robin: seeing repeated container restarts on us-west-2-gpu-pool around 03:14 UTC, pager triggered
sahil: oncall, I'm taking this. pulling runtime logs and recent prefill traces
anna: customer C-349 reported ~6% error rate during window, flagging CS impact
mike: likely long-context prefill growth + KV cache retention. can we throttle prefill length as a fast mitigation?
sahil: confirming CUDA OOMs in logs: "out of memory when allocating 3.2G" during prefill step, kvcache size ramped quickly
oncall_robin: okay. prioritize stop-anything-that-causes-eviction. sahil, coordinate cordon/drain if node is noisy
customer-success-ellie: informing affected customers: "we're investigating increased errors, temporarily routing traffic to backup model" :hourglass_flowing_sand:
sahil: starting rolling config change to clamp prefill_max_tokens 16384->8192 on the affected route (canary 2 nodes)
ops-bot: Action logged: sahil initiated config change at 03:18 UTC
mike: enabling fallback to quantized model variant for heavy routes, should reduce footprint by ~35%
anna: eviction logs show stranding of large KV pages; containers restarted between 03:16-03:21 UTC
sahil: running immediate remediation commands:
```
kubectl cordon gpu-node-17
kubectl drain gpu-node-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force
```
no blockers
oncall_robin: approved, proceed
customer-success-ellie: sent update to customers: "we routed requests and restarted affected sessions; monitoring closely" :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Pager cleared by oncall_robin at 03:28 UTC
sahil: collecting heapdumps, nvcrash logs, and kernel traces. will upload artifacts to incident ticket INC-705432 and link repro prompts
mike: canary of prefill estimator and quantized fallback scheduled on 2 nodes, monitoring token-level memory metrics
anna: adding note: prioritize alert to trigger when kvcache > 3GB per session; current alert too high
oncall_robin: TL;DR: cause = GPU OOM during prefill from long-context requests + KV cache growth; mitigations = clamp prefill length, quantized fallback, cordon/drain noisy nodes, route to lower-memory model; owners = sahil/mike/anna; follow-ups = post-incident RCA and alert tuning
customer-success-ellie: I'll follow up with customers once RCA is ready
sahil: leaving an ops checklist in the ticket and a short timeline, will avoid silent restarts in next deploy
ops-bot: Incident note appended: mitigation actions and owners recorded
